text:
Maya (Partnerships): quick sketch - want a single private-offer for HW+SI that supports a ramp schedule, escrowed seller credits, and an emergency decommit flow. Keep sales UX to one link.
Ian (Sales): +1. must be simple for customers: '12mo commit, monthly billing, credits vest monthly, optional adoption accel'. Sales needs a one-click offer URL and a short FAQ.
Noor (Finance): must include GL tags per seller line and a monthly reconciliation CSV. want provisional vs released ledger flags and a negative-usage reversal window (120d).
Raj (Eng-Billing): infra notes: add offer metadata fields `seller_split`, `ramp_profile`, `escrow_policy`, `decommit_policy`. usage events need `offer_id` + `line_id` + `seller_tag` for attribution. creating ticket INF-5100.
ops-bot: INF-5100 created - "offer-level escrow + ramp + decommit handling" assigned to eng-billing.
Tess (Field Ops): ops asks: automated ramp checks (monthly), deployment smoke test for gating, webhook to AMs on shortfall >10% for 2 months, and a dashboard tile showing escrowed vs releasable.
Maya (Partnerships): draft ramp proposal: month1 >=40%, month2 >=60%, month3 >=80% or shortfall fee applies. emergency decommit: 30d notice + audit runbook; one-time per contract.
Ian (Sales): suggest an optional 3-month prepay to waive decommit penalties for that window and a small non-refundable 5% adoption accel that converts to seller credit after deployment verified.
Noor (Finance): prepay recorded as deferred revenue; adoption accel must sit as liability until converted. reconciliation CSV columns: offer_id, month, committed_paid, actual_usage_value, shortfall_fee, escrow_withheld, escrow_released, decommit_settlement, gl_code.
Raj (Eng-Billing): plan: 1) extend usage event schema, 2) ledger provisional entries monthly, 3) API POST /escrow/settle for decommit settlement, 4) webhook events for ramp/shortfall. will post RFC in #eng-billing.
Tess (Field Ops): owners: Ian -> sales collateral + FAQ; Noor -> reconciliation spec; Raj -> INF-5100 + RFC + settlement endpoint; Maya -> customer-facing one-pager and pilot coordination. target: pilot with 1 HW + 1 SI in 6 weeks.
Maya (Partnerships): thanks all. small next step: Ian will mock a single-offer demo URL and Tess will sketch webhook payloads. ping if blockers. :rocket:
